# fx documentation

> fx is a coding agent for your terminal. libfx runs the fx agent from JavaScript in Node.js or the browser.

Each link below opens a Markdown version of the documentation.

## getting started

- [Quick start](https://fx.sh/docs.md): Install fx and send your first prompt.
- [Installation](https://fx.sh/docs/getting-started/installation.md): Install and update fx on macOS or Linux.
- [Authentication](https://fx.sh/docs/getting-started/authentication.md): Connect an account or API key for model requests.
## using fx

- [Working with fx](https://fx.sh/docs/using-fx/working-with-fx.md): Send a prompt, steer fx, and review the result.
- [Sessions](https://fx.sh/docs/using-fx/sessions.md): Return to a conversation, recover interrupted work, and manage context.
- [Context compaction](https://fx.sh/docs/using-fx/context-compaction.md): Understand when fx compacts a conversation and what it keeps.
- [Subagents](https://fx.sh/docs/capabilities/subagents.md): Delegate independent work and continue it with follow-up prompts.
- [Web search](https://fx.sh/docs/capabilities/web-search.md): Search current public information or read a known URL.
- [Vision](https://fx.sh/docs/capabilities/vision.md): Give fx screenshots, diagrams, and other images to work with.
## configure fx

- [Models](https://fx.sh/docs/configure-fx/models.md): Choose a model and adjust its reasoning effort.
- [Custom model connections](https://fx.sh/docs/configure-fx/custom-model-connections.md): Connect fx to Ollama, vLLM, OpenRouter, and compatible endpoints.
- [Permissions](https://fx.sh/docs/configure-fx/permissions.md): Control tool execution with modes, rules, and session grants.
- [Project instructions](https://fx.sh/docs/configure-fx/project-instructions.md): Give fx the commands and conventions it needs for your project.
- [Additional workspaces](https://fx.sh/docs/configure-fx/additional-workspaces.md): Give fx access to additional directories while keeping one primary workspace.
## extend fx

- [Skills](https://fx.sh/docs/capabilities/skills.md): Discover, load, install, and create reusable agent instructions.
- [MCP](https://fx.sh/docs/capabilities/mcp.md): Connect fx to MCP servers, sign in, and use their tools.
## reference

- [CLI commands](https://fx.sh/docs/using-fx/cli.md): Reference for top-level fx commands and global flags.
- [Slash commands](https://fx.sh/docs/using-fx/slash-commands.md): Reference for commands inside the interactive shell.
- [Configuration](https://fx.sh/docs/configure-fx/configuration.md): Reference for fx settings, scopes, defaults, and environment variables.
- [Context limits](https://fx.sh/docs/configure-fx/context-limits.md): Adjust how much text fx loads from instructions, skills, MCP tools, and image analysis.
- [Tools](https://fx.sh/docs/capabilities/tools.md): Built-in tools available to the fx agent.
- [MCP protocol reference](https://fx.sh/docs/capabilities/mcp/protocol.md): Transports, protocol coverage, schema handling, and isolation for the fx MCP client.

- [ACP server](https://fx.sh/docs/using-fx/acp.md): Run fx from editors and clients that support Agent Client Protocol.
## help

- [Troubleshooting](https://fx.sh/docs/using-fx/troubleshooting.md): Diagnose install, authentication, model, permission, session, and terminal problems.
- [Usage and costs](https://fx.sh/docs/using-fx/usage-and-costs.md): Check token usage, recorded costs, and account billing.
- [Data and privacy](https://fx.sh/docs/using-fx/data-and-privacy.md): Understand what leaves your machine and what fx stores locally.
- [Share feedback](https://fx.sh/docs/using-fx/share-feedback.md): Report an fx problem and collect private diagnostics for terminal issues.

- [Overview](https://fx.sh/docs/lib.md): Run the fx agent from JavaScript in Node.js or the browser.
- [Quick start](https://fx.sh/docs/lib/quick-start.md): Install libfx and stream your first reply.
- [Examples](https://fx.sh/docs/lib/examples.md): Build with libfx in Node.js, the browser, Next.js, and Nuxt.
## libfx / build an agent

- [Prompts and streaming](https://fx.sh/docs/lib/prompts.md): Send prompts, read events, and continue a conversation.
- [Models](https://fx.sh/docs/lib/models.md): Choose a model, reasoning effort, and fast mode.
- [Tools](https://fx.sh/docs/lib/tools.md): Give the agent JavaScript functions to call.
- [Images](https://fx.sh/docs/lib/images.md): Send images alongside a prompt.
- [Steering](https://fx.sh/docs/lib/steering.md): Send follow-up instructions while the agent works.
- [Save and restore](https://fx.sh/docs/lib/checkpoints.md): Save a conversation and continue it in a new agent.
## libfx / integrations

- [MCP](https://fx.sh/docs/lib/mcp.md): Connect MCP server tools to a libfx agent.
- [Skills](https://fx.sh/docs/lib/skills.md): Load skill instructions into an agent.

- [Terminal](https://fx.sh/docs/lib/terminal.md): Embed the fx terminal and connect storage, login, and workspace adapters.
